name: To Serve Kum'isha
label: Quest
description: To Serve Kum'isha: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Traveler, can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, traveler... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have dedicated my life to the search of flawless draenethyst spheres. A lifetime, traveler!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do my eyes deceive me? Impossible! Where did you... How...
Perhaps now a rift can be opened, returning us to our homeland.
